On Wed, May 11, 2022 at 5:25 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi All,
Just for your SA. I'm being intro'd to a bunch of folks in CPC for intros which I think is good. Any thoughts are
welcome before I start these rounds.
For background:
Julie Werbel who l've known for over a decade reached out and pinged me and facilitated all of this.
On CMC - I've worked a ton with COCOMs in my prior life and SOF, so a bit of a familiar territory.
I know OTI has a lot of disinfo programminh as well.
Cheers, Vera

Dear CPS colleagues,
With this email, I would like to introduce you to Vera Zakem who recently joined DDI/DRG where she will lead
a portfolio focused on technology and democracy, including mis- dis- and malinformation (MDM). She's
interested in connecting with CPS Bureau leadership and experts tracking this space.
You can find her pre-USAID bio here. Please look out for further correspondence from her or feel free to reach
out directly.
Best,
Julie
